spanish: A la par del marco serán los anillos, a casas a varas para alzar la mesa.
grammarChanges: Removed the definite article from "las varas" (h02025027006, לְבַדִּים, absolute plural with no article) to "varas", matching the parallel absolute noun "casas" (h02025027005, לְבָתִּים) which already carries no article.
